verdict.rationale: Meltano documents scheduled pipelines orchestrated via Apache Airflow, allowing ELT jobs to run unattended/autonomously in the background, and CLI commands support fully automated pipeline execution. However, this is traditional cron/orchestrator-based scheduling rather than AI-native, agent-driven autonomy (no evidence of AI agents deciding when/what to run or reacting dynamically). Missing for 10: AI-agent-triggered automation, dynamic/adaptive scheduling logic, and independent evidence of autonomous background operation beyond docs.
